newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde May 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde May 2.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Britain's Labour Party wins historical victory, seen winning at least 420 of 659 seats in the House of Commons.

-- Socialist party leader Lionel Jospin presented a platform for the upcoming parliamentary election on Friday, including plans to cut value-added tax on basic goods and raise wealth tax, cut work week to 35 hours and create some 700,000 jobs.

-- U.S. engine manufacturer Pratt & Whitney reluctant to build engine for extended version of Airbus A-340 if competitors Rolls-Royce and General Electric are also involved, head of engine division Robert Wolfe said.
-- Associates at Arthur Andersen consulting group vote against separating computer consulting from other activities.
-- German insurer Allianz does not rule out investing in the French insurance market, is mentioned by GAN chairman Didier Pfeiffer as a possible bidder for GAN privatisation.
